hero.subhead: Open source Kubernetes controller for consistent configurations, policies, and add-ons across all your clusters.

oss.heading: Orchestrating deployments across your Kubernetes fleet

features.title: Orchestrated Deployment Order
features.desc: Deploy custom resources in your defined order. Ensure deployments are predictable and controlled across every cluster.
features.detail: Sveltos intuitively understands dependencies. You can define precisely which Helm charts or Kubernetes YAMLs must be deployed first, preventing race conditions and ensuring complex stateful applications bootstrap correctly every time.

features.title: Powerful Templating
features.desc: Represent add-ons as templates and let Sveltos automatically inject cluster-specific details for consistent deployments.
features.detail: Write your manifests once. Sveltos dynamically patches them at deployment time using cluster labels, annotations, or information retrieved directly from the management cluster, reducing copy-paste errors and configuration drift.

features.title: Multitenancy
features.desc: Designed for multitenancy from the beginning. Use ClusterProfile and Profile resources for complete isolation or tenant sharing.
features.detail: Strictly partition your managed clusters across different teams. Sveltos ensures tenant configurations cannot conflict, applying rigorous RBAC policies and resource quotas seamlessly across your distributed infrastructure.

features.title: Event-Driven Automation
features.desc: Deploy add-ons and applications in response to specific events using Lua or CEL to adapt dynamically.
features.detail: Don't just deploy statically; react to cluster state. Write custom Lua or CEL scripts to detect when new nodes join, specific pods crash, or custom metrics trigger, and automatically deploy remediation manifests or scaling workloads.

features.title: Observability
features.desc: Get notifications through Slack, Teams, Discord, WebEx, Telegram, SMTP, or Kubernetes events.
features.detail: Stay informed about the state of your fleet. Sveltos natively integrates with major communication platforms to broadcast deployment statuses, drift detections, and policy violations directly to your team's preferred channels.

features.title: Pull Mode
features.desc: Deploy add-ons in restricted environments; clusters behind firewalls, air-gapped setups, and edge environments.
features.detail: Secure your management plane by eliminating inbound connections. In Pull Mode, a lightweight agent in the managed cluster securely reaches out to the management cluster, making it ideal for edge devices and zero-trust networks.

features.title: Progressive Rollouts
features.desc: Perform phased rollouts of cluster configurations. Define once, then list deployment stages in order.
features.detail: Minimize blast radius by staging deployments. Roll out changes to your dev clusters first, then staging, and finally production. Sveltos pauses automatically if a stage fails, ensuring fleet-wide stability.

enterprise.heading: Secure management without exposing your clusters

bullets.title: Agent-initiated Pull Mode
bullets.text: Sveltos agent connects outbound to the management plane. No need to open inbound ports or expose API servers.

bullets.title: Air-Gapped & Edge Ready
bullets.text: Perfect for clusters behind strict firewalls, air-gapped setups, and highly regulated edge environments.

howItWorks.heading: From management cluster to every managed cluster

steps.title: Label-Based Targeting
steps.desc: Select clusters using Kubernetes labels. ClusterProfiles and Profiles determine who gets what.

steps.title: ClusterProfiles / Profiles
steps.desc: Define desired add-ons, configurations, and policies declaratively as CRDs.

steps.title: Sync Modes
steps.desc: Choose OneTime, Continuous, or ContinuousWithDriftDetection to match your operational needs.

steps.title: Deployment Phases
steps.desc: Stage deployments across clusters with ordering and dependency control built in.

steps.title: Management Cluster
steps.desc: A single management cluster orchestrates and distributes configs to all registered clusters.

steps.title: Managed Clusters
steps.desc: Each managed cluster runs a lightweight Sveltos agent and receives state from the management plane.
